about_the_game:
Black Shadow is a first-person survival horror game. You will play as investigator Eric Stone, who ventures into a mysterious zone filled with dark matter in search of truth and a way out. In a land shrouded by darkness, no one is truly safe. Your only hope lies in staying calm, moving carefully, and relying on your instinct to survive.

Story

Across the Earth, regions of strange black mist—known as the “Black Shadow”—have emerged. Probes reveal immense energy hidden inside, yet no signs of hostility have been observed.

The Federal Research Institute dispatches investigator Eric Stone to one of these mist zones, hoping he can discover a way to harness this mysterious power.

But during his mission, Eric becomes trapped in a distorted timeline, forced to confront an overwhelming terror.
When he finally breaks free, he finds that the world outside is no longer the same…

Core Gameplay

  • Stealth & Hiding: You cannot fight back against the unknown. Stay quiet, move cautiously, and find places to hide.

  • Exploration & Puzzles: Gather clues, solve environmental puzzles, and slowly uncover the secrets within the mist.

  • Survival Challenges: Limited light, oppressive environments, and constant danger will push your instincts to the limit.

Key Features

  • Immersive First-Person Horror: Experience the suffocating tension of darkness all around you.

  • Dynamic Fear Elements: Enemies and events are unpredictable, making every playthrough tense and unique.

  • Narrative-Driven Adventure: As the investigation deepens, you will gradually uncover the truth behind the “Black Shadow.”

How long can you endure the fear—before it consumes you completely?

short_description: Black Shadow is a first-person survival horror game built with UE5. Players take on the role of investigator Eric Stone, who ventures into a dark-matter zone. You must explore warped timelines, sneak through the shadows, and evade unknown threats while gradually uncovering hidden secrets.
